title: Claude background-end rival rows are too broad and a row that never ends blocks every later match in its session and worktree
outcome: Only launch rows that could own the candidate registration contest a Claude background-end match: recognised launcher rows of the same mode, or of the same planned focused argv. A row that never records an end cannot block later matches indefinitely.
acceptance: Claude background-end rival rows are too broad and a row that never ends blocks every later match in its session and worktree is done
